value.rationale: The class is the canonical 321-avoiding-involution family with central-binomial enumeration and two-row-tableau interpretation; pairwise ordinal comparisons provide a natural learning-theoretic observable. Exact finite classification locates the first two-unit static/adaptive separation at n=11, and root information obstructions 126<128 and 252<256 at n=11,12 expose a mathematically specific threshold not implied by counts or ambient dimensions. The exact self-contained ranks are reusable benchmarks; no general theorem beyond n=12 is claimed.
